questions.question: Do I need to write code to track events?
questions.answer: A short snippet is enough to capture page views and clicks automatically. For custom events you add one line per event, and our docs have copy-paste examples for the common frameworks.

questions.question: Can I import my existing data?
questions.answer: Yes. You can upload a CSV or connect your warehouse, and Pulsebase will backfill up to 24 months of events so your charts are useful from day one.

questions.question: What happens if I go over my event limit?
questions.answer: We never cut off your data. You get a warning at 80% and again at 100%, and you can upgrade or let the extra events wait until next month.

questions.question: Is my data used to train anything?
questions.answer: No. Your events are yours, they are never shared and they are deleted from our servers when you ask.
